raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Purpose

In decoder replay steps, the last KV-source layer (layer 20 on DSV4.1-Flash) still ran on every row, though for the trimmed rows only its KV (SWA, compressed, index K) is read. Its indexer scoring and top-k, sparse MLA, wo and MoE feed only the replay layers.

- The cut layer now writes its KV for every row (`DeepseekV4DecoderLayer.write_kv` → `DeepseekV4Attention.forward_kv`), then runs as the first replay layer (`decoder_replay_start = cut`) on the replay rows, in the replay batch and its CUDA graphs. Its sliding-window metadata keeps the batch's window starts, so it stays exact. The indexer row-buffer compaction goes.
- PIECEWISE graphs now decide the replay break (and `write_kv`) by graph size (`DecoderReplayLayers.replays()`) instead of `replay_batch is not None`, which is unset at capture: before, the break was never captured and PIECEWISE steps did not trim.

## Results

DSV4.1-Flash DEP4 on B200, CUDA graphs up to 8192 tokens, `vllm bench serve` random. Baseline: #59532 with PIECEWISE trimming working, layer 20 not cut.

| | baseline | this PR | |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| 8k in / 1 out, C16, total tok/s | 236,952 | 245,556 | +3.6% |
| 32k in / 1 out, C16 | 235,791 | 245,996 | +4.3% |
| 128k in / 1 out, C4 | 194,012 | 204,764 | +5.5% |
| 32k in / 256 out, C32, output tok/s | 1,281 | 1,303 | +1.7% |

GSM8K 5-shot: 0.9606 both.

AgentX C128 (InferenceX DEP4 recipe, synthetic AL 3.51, 3,600 s), nightly 43b4aaea + this PR vs. the InferenceX CI run ([37070984585](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/37070984585), dev image ac9126):

| | CI | this PR | |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| output tok/s | 5,446 | 5,575 | +2.4% |
| TTFT mean / p50 / p99 (ms) | 293 / 163 / 2,558 | 255 / 155 / 2,004 | |
| ITL mean / p50 / p99 (ms) | 8.66 / 7.60 / 29.3 | 8.21 / 7.36 / 24.0 | |
| per-user output tok/s | 132.0 | 136.6 | +3.5% |
| requests completed | 18,804 | 19,572 | +4.1% |

Prefix cache hit 95.2% in both.

@gcanlin Hi Canlin, thanks for the contribution! We just merged #59532, which should further improve decoder replay performance. Would you mind rebasing this PR on top of the latest main, including #59532, and rerunning the benchmarks with a larger CUDA graph size (e.g. 8192) so we can evaluate the incremental gains on top of it?

Also, while rebasing, could you please do a quick cleanup of the PR where applicable, removing any changes that are no longer needed or are now covered by #59532, so that the remaining diff is easier to review? Thanks!

https://docs.github.com/en/pull-requests/collaborating-with-pull-requests/working-with-forks/syncing-a-fork

## Claude Code Review

This pull request is from a fork — automated review is disabled. A repository maintainer can comment `@claude review` to run a one-time review.

IIUC, we need to add this PIECEWISE parameter to enable building replay batch, otherwise the path can't go into graph for replay decoder. Can you double-check it? I just let agent to find the inferenceX CI config and code. It's different from the merged version(#59532). I failed enabling graph for replay decoder without this fix. @Juntian777 


```
def _prepare_replay_batch(self, input_batch, cudagraph_mode, ..., capture_desc=None):
    ....
    force_replay_batch = capture_desc is not None or (
        cudagraph_mode == CUDAGraphMode.PIECEWISE
        and self._trim_threshold is not None
        and input_batch.num_tokens_after_padding >= self._trim_threshold
    )
```

Same as above, we should also avoid using self.decoder_replay_layers.replay_batch as the condition here. forward gates write_kv on replay_batch is not None, which is None at capture but set at runtime, same as the break.
Could we share the PIECEWISE graph-size predicate between replays() and _prepare_replay_batch()? Capture and runtime should use the same policy, but currently they implement it separately.

inline_comments.body:
IIUC, we need to add this PIECEWISE parameter to enable building replay batch, otherwise the path can't go into graph for replay decoder. Can you double-check it? I just let agent to find the inferenceX CI config and code. It's different from the merged version(#59532). I failed enabling graph for replay decoder without this fix. @Juntian777 


```
def _prepare_replay_batch(self, input_batch, cudagraph_mode, ..., capture_desc=None):
    ....
    force_replay_batch = capture_desc is not None or (
        cudagraph_mode == CUDAGraphMode.PIECEWISE
        and self._trim_threshold is not None
        and input_batch.num_tokens_after_padding >= self._trim_threshold
    )
```

Same as above, we should also avoid using self.decoder_replay_layers.replay_batch as the condition here. forward gates write_kv on replay_batch is not None, which is None at capture but set at runtime, same as the break.
Could we share the PIECEWISE graph-size predicate between replays() and _prepare_replay_batch()? Capture and runtime should use the same policy, but currently they implement it separately.
